town_description: Mon is the headquarters town of Mon district in northern Nagaland, the heartland of the Konyak Naga tribe, reached by a long hill road from Assam via Naharkatia/Sonari. Remote and predominantly Christian, it is known for traditional Konyak villages, woodcraft and the nearby Myanmar border; Indian visitors from outside Nagaland need an Inner Line Permit (ILP).
